# Đạo Đồ build pieces: el-thuy (generated by tools/design/world/depth_tree.py index)

Organised by **idea** (the tree's big clusters, `design/dao-do/big-cluster-ideas-v5.md`), nearest to the start first, then the small clusters. For each piece: its theme lines and capability, then every notable and keystone in it with its exact lines and, for an Effect, the rule. **Targets** = the ids of the notables / keystone you want from a piece, nearest first (the route opens the small nodes between). `d` = points from the start (thuy). Check routes with `python -I tools/design/world/depth_tree.py route <key>`.

## Keystones of this land (a build's capstone: big lines, one rule, and a closing cost)
- **9003** Rising Tide (Triều Dâng): linh_luc_pct 25, linh_luc_regen_pct 1.09; effect: Rising Tide (Triều Dâng); closes: while your linh lực is below half, your Water buff stacks do nothing; rule: While your linh lực is above half, your Water stacks count double. Closes: while it is below half, your Water stacks do nothing.; ends: full-pool caster (d 7)
- **9004** Ebb Tide (Triều Rút): attack_pct 37.5[thuy], art_speed_pct 62.5[thuy]; effect: Ebb Tide (Triều Rút); closes: maximum linh lực −15 %; rule: The first time in a fight your linh lực falls below 30 %, restore 30 % of it. Closes: maximum linh lực -15 %.; ends: comeback caster (d 7)
- **9011** Metal Begets Water (Kim Sinh Thủy): attack_pct 37.5[kim], linh_luc_regen_pct 1.09; effect: Metal Begets Water (Kim Sinh Thủy); closes: arts of Wood (Mộc) you slot deal 50 % less; rule: Each hit of a Metal art you land adds one Water buff stack to you. Closes: Fire arts you slot deal 50 % less.; ends: Ice debuff (d 16)
- **9013** Water Begets Wood (Thủy Sinh Mộc): health_regen_pct 2.52, linh_luc_pct 25; effect: Water Begets Wood (Thủy Sinh Mộc); closes: arts of Earth (Thổ) you slot deal 50 % less; rule: Your Water buff stacks also count as Wood buff stacks. Closes: Earth arts you slot deal 50 % less.; ends: Water-Wood hybrid (d 16)
- **9014** Returning Wave (Hồi Lãng): resist_pct 937[cold], evade_pct 16.6; effect: Returning Wave (Hồi Lãng); closes: maximum health −15 % (`khi_huyet_pct` −15); rule: The first hit you take in each fight does you no harm and strikes the foe instead, at full damage. Closes: maximum health -15 %.; ends: reflect, evasion (d 20)
